title: Weight change for a list of fixed coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta<1$, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each coordinate in $[n]$, let $L$ be a list of distinct coordinates, and let $x$ be a binary vector of length $n$. If every coordinate in $L$ is free in $\rho$, then the weight of $\rho$ equals $\bigl(2\delta/(1-\delta)\bigr)^{|L|}$ times the weight obtained by fixing each coordinate in $L$ according to the corresponding sign encoded by $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns a restriction state to each coordinate
